registered_closure_families.rule: propagate takes injected callables. The parity inputs are the registered closed-form families below, implemented identically (same operation order) in the harness (Python) and in the parity binary (Rust). They are SYNTHETIC_TEST_DATA_NOT_EVIDENCE: no atmosphere, drag or thruster claim; the frozen-data drag / thrust of the active simulator never enters this contract
registered_closure_families.DF-EXP: drag_fn(alt, t_h): a = R_EARTH + alt * 1e3; rho = rho0 * exp(-(alt - h0) / H); V = sqrt(MU_EARTH / a); D = 0.5 * rho * V ** 2 * CdA; returns (D, {'rho': rho}). Parameters rho0 [kg m-3], h0 [km], H [km], CdA [m2]
registered_closure_families.TF-POWER: thrust_fn(alt, t_h, atm): P = min(Pmax, atm['_P_avail']); returns (k * P, P)  (Python min: the first argument unless the second is smaller)
registered_closure_families.TF-TRACK: thrust_fn(alt, t_h, atm): a = R_EARTH + alt * 1e3; V = sqrt(MU_EARTH / a); D = 0.5 * atm['rho'] * V ** 2 * CdA; returns (f * D, P0)

list.name: beta_deg
list.definition: degrees(asin(cos d sin i sin(O - ls) + sin d cos i)) with i, O, ls, d = radians(inputs)

list.name: status
list.definition: EVALUATED or the mapped status of the Python exception (and its class)

list.name: eclipse_frac
list.definition: a = R_EARTH + 1e3 alt; b = radians(|beta|); arg = sqrt(max(a ** 2 - R_EARTH ** 2, 0)) / (a cos b) if cos b > 0 else 0; 0 if arg >= 1 or cos b == 0 else acos(arg) / pi

list.name: f_ecl_max
list.definition: max over day = 0, 2, ..., 364 of eclipse_fraction(alt, beta_angle(inc, raan(day), sun_lon(day), dec(day))) with sun_lon = (day / 365.25 * 360) % 360, dec = 23.44 sin(radians(sun_lon)), raan = (sun_lon + (ltan_h - 12) * 15) % 360; start 0.0; Python max keeps the running value unless the new one is greater

list.name: array_area_m2
list.definition: (min(P * rho_ratio, P_cap) + hk) / (SOLAR_CONST * eff * (1 - deg * years) * (1 - f_ecl_max) * eps) with f_ecl_max = worst_eclipse_fraction(sc, alt)

list.name: n_rows
list.definition: number of DataFrame rows (loop length incl. the re-entry break)

list.name: rows[*].{alt_km, beta_deg, eclipse_frac, D_mN, T_mN, P_bus_W, P_need_W, P_avail_W, power_margin_W, rho}
list.units: km, deg, 1, mN, mN, W, W, W, W, kg m-3
list.definition: the per-step quantities of propagate (secular J2 RAAN drift, beta, eclipse, energy-balance altitude rate 2 a^1.5 (T - D) / (m sqrt(MU)), array power); a recurrence, so the relative clause covers ulp-level differences carried forward

tolerance.comparison: on the circle: d = |rust - py|; d = min(d, 360 - d)

list.name: raan_drift_deg_per_day
list.definition: median(|diff(raan_deg)|) / (dt_h / 24) if rows > 2 else 0.0 (median: middle element, or the mean (a + b) / 2 of the two middle elements)

list.name: status
list.definition: EVALUATED or the mapped status of the Python exception (and its class)

tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, booleans, statuses, error classes, row counts, and floats that are copied or formed by one exactly reproducible product (t_h, hours_power_short): equal (floats by value, -0.0 == 0.0)
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= k_ulp * ulp(py) OR |rust - py| <= r_rel * |py| OR |rust - py| <= a_abs, with the clauses fixed per observable above (an absent clause is not applied); ulp(py) = 2^(floor(log2|py|) - 52) (py = 0: smallest subnormal)
tolerance_classes.EXACT_STREAM: not used (no RNG in the scoped functions)

tolerance_basis.independence: fixed before any comparison from the operation list
tolerance_basis.registered: both implementations evaluate glibc sin / cos / asin / acos / sqrt / exp / pow (CPython math.* and float ** int call libm; Rust f64 methods call the same libm) and IEEE basic operations in the same order. k_ulp = 4 covers an LLVM rewrite of pow(x, 2.0) into x * x (< 1 ulp against glibc pow) propagated through one more libm call. propagate is a recurrence over up to ~400 steps: r_rel 1e-12 bounds an ulp-level difference amplified along the trajectory (the altitude rate is smooth in alt); a_abs 1e-12 covers quantities that cross zero (power margin, T - D in mN). raan is periodic: compared on the circle so that a wrap at 0 / 360 caused by an ulp is not a spurious failure. raan_drift is a median of differences of a mod-360 quantity: r_rel 1e-9 / a_abs 1e-9

exact_invariants.statement: double-run determinism of the CLI output (byte-identical) and of the Python values

propagate rows: t_h = k dt_h for k = 0..n-1 (strictly increasing), eclipse_frac in [0, 1], P_need_W = P_bus_W + bus_housekeeping_W exactly, power_margin_W = P_avail_W - P_need_W exactly, raan_deg in [0, 360)
worst_eclipse_fraction(sc, alt) >= eclipse_fraction(alt, beta) for every (day, beta) of its own scan (it is their running maximum)

conservation_checks.reason: propagate integrates an energy balance: the semi-major-axis rate from the specific orbital energy -MU / (2a) and the power (T - D) V

checks.statement: per step, the altitude increment equals dadt * dt_h * 3600 / 1e3 with dadt = 2 a^1.5 (T - D) / (m sqrt(MU)) evaluated from the row values of the previous altitude (recomputed by the harness from the previous altitude and the row D_mN / T_mN of each implementation)
checks.tolerance: |row increment - recomputed increment| <= 1e-9 |recomputed increment| + 1e-12 km, every step, both implementations

checks.statement: T - D = 0 for every step (TF-TRACK with f = 1) keeps the altitude exactly constant in both implementations
